messages:
Riley: Quick non-work update  - we adopted a rescue pup last night! Meet Miso (photos incoming). We're bringing tiny dog treats to the office tomorrow for anyone who wants to say hi. :dog: :heart_eyes:
Noah: AWWW congrats!! Please post pics. Is Miso good with laptops?
Sasha: Congrats Riley!! If this is an onboarding question, I volunteer as belly-rub QA.
Riley: Pics attached in the thread (will post one in #random after lunch). Miso is already a pro snoozer, slightly suspicious of the Roomba.
Jordan: Welcome to puppy parenthood 60d Bring treats and I'll bring a collapsible water bowl. Also can confirm: dogs do not respect calendar boundaries.
PeopleOps: Cute doggy policy reminder: employees may bring well-behaved pets to the office on non-client days, please ensure vaccinations are up to date and pet is comfortable in shared spaces. If you plan to bring Miso, please label and keep on leash in public areas.
Riley: Thanks PeopleOps, we'll follow the rules. We'll aim for a quiet corner and won't bring Miso to the client meeting rooms.
Noah: Also can we do a 10-min "welcome Miso" at 2pm? Purely optional, bring snacks for humans and dogs.
Sasha: I'm in for 2pm. Will bring puppy-safe treats and a tiny party hat (optional for the dog).
CateringBot: Note: Food brought into the office must be nut-free. If you plan to bring store-bought dog treats, label them "pet only" and keep them separate from human food.
Riley: Will do. Appreciate the support and the belly-rub volunteers. Miso says hi and demands belly rubs already. :dog2:
Jordan: Post a boop pic later and I'll craft a tiny "Welcome Miso" banner for the kitchen.
Sasha: Can't wait 389389 Congrats again Riley!!
Riley: Thank you all. See you and Miso at 2pm (or feel free to drop by reception for treats).
